notes.title: MacOS Support
notes.content:
Howdy all!

Just updating the MacOS build with some of the Kaycee's Mod expansion as well as optimizations and bugfixes.  Eventually we'll be trying to reach parity with the PC version, but there are still a few platform specific bugs that need to be squashed before it'll be ready for prime time.
So give it a shot, and don't forget to report any bugs or give your feedback using F11 while in game!
